description: Ministry of Water Supply -  Order to acquire the lands in Pathahewaheta  and  Medadadumbara  D/S Division's Kandy District for Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of immovable property and servitude rights over specific land parcels for water supply infrastructure projects. The document includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and claimant information, making it clearly focused on land and property matters rather than government personnel changes or other administrative categories.
